description: A module that exports plugin definitions, schemas related to text-to-speech configurations, request handling utilities, and type definitions for a voice-call plugin. It appears to serve as a surface layer/interface for the voice-call feature, re-exporting and importing various utilities and types.

methods.name: definePluginEntry
methods.description: Exports the plugin entry point definition, imported from external plugin-entry.js.

methods.name: isRequestBodyLimitError
methods.description: Checks if an error pertains to request body size limits, imported from http-body.js.

methods.name: readRequestBodyWithLimit
methods.description: Reads HTTP request body respecting size limits, imported from http-body.js.

methods.name: requestBodyErrorToText
methods.description: Converts request body errors to descriptive text, imported from http-body.js.

methods.name: fetchWithSsrFGuard
methods.description: Fetch utility with server-side rendering guard, imported from fetch-guard.js.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Utility to delay execution, imported from utils.js.
